unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U11: Apply financial defaults,firm-property and personal-profit accounting

payload.title: Start with the agreement, then use the statutory default
payload.core_explanation_md:
In the absence of a contrary contract, the described defaults include equal sharing of profits and losses and no automatic remuneration for participating in the business. Interest on capital, where payable under the stated rule, is payable out of profits. A qualifying advance beyond agreed capital is treated differently: the source specifies six per cent per annum. Do not confuse this default with a current bank lending rate or silently override an agreed term.

Property acquired for the firm and goodwill require firm-property analysis rather than treating title in one partner name as decisive. Benefits obtained through firm transactions, property or business connections and competing-business profits can require accounting to the firm, subject to the governing agreement. Reconstitution or continuation of a fixed-term venture also needs the section 17 default-continuity analysis.

self_check.prompt_text: Does working more hours create an automatic salary entitlement under the default?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Examine the agreement; the default does not provide automatic remuneration.

payload.stem_md: The agreement is silent on remuneration and one partner demands salary solely for managing daily operations. What is the appropriate starting point?

options.text_md: Salary is automatically equal to the bank manager salary
No automatic remuneration under the described default; examine any agreement
options.explanation_md: Participation alone does not establish the claimed salary.

options.text_md: No partner can ever agree to remuneration
options.explanation_md: The default can be subject to contract.

options.text_md: The largest capital contribution automatically fixes salary
options.explanation_md: Capital alone does not establish remuneration.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Participation alone does not establish the claimed salary.

payload.stem_md: A partner secretly earns a benefit through the firm business connections and keeps it outside firm accounts. What should be examined?

options.text_md: Whether the personal account has a debit card
Whether a secret benefit is always exempt from accounting
options.explanation_md: The source identifies a contrary duty.

options.text_md: Only whether the firm remains profitable
options.explanation_md: Profitability does not settle the accounting duty.

options.text_md: The governing agreement and personal-profit accounting duty
options.explanation_md: The origin and authorisation of the benefit matter.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The origin and authorisation of the benefit matter.
